description: Accounts of this instance. Each holds one role; the admin role holds every permission.
deactivate_description: The account can no longer sign in and its sessions and API tokens stop working. Its drafts are kept; you can reactivate it later.

create.title: Create a user
create.description: A local account, signing in with a username and password. The user must choose a new password at their first sign-in.
create.generate_hint: Shown once, after creation: copy it and give it to the user.
create.done_generated: {{name}} was created. Give them this temporary password; it is shown only once.
create.done: {{name}} was created. Give them the temporary password you chose.

reset_description: Give it to the user, who must choose a new one at their next sign-in. Their current sessions end.
roles_description: The five built-in roles, each including the one before it.

error.last_admin: This is the last active administrator: promote another account first.
error.self_deactivation: You cannot deactivate your own account.
error.admin_only: Only an administrator may give or take the admin role.
error.username_taken: An account already has this username.
error.email_taken: An account already has this email.
